Two-asset volatility equals sqrt(wA²sigmaA²+wB²sigmaB²+2wAwB rho sigmaA sigmaB).
Two equal 20%-sigma assets at equal weights and rho0 produce 14.14% volatility, rho1=20%, rho-1=0% idealized.
CAPM is a conditional equilibrium pricing model; with Rf3%, market premium6%, beta1.2 implies expected 10.2%.

claims: NBS PMI is monthly diffusion index with expansion-contraction threshold 50; not GDP growth.
Monetary transmission can affect safe yields, risk premia and expected cash flow differently.
Exact Fisher real rate formula for nominal 5%, inflation 2% yields 2.94%.
GICS is a taxonomy with 11 broad sectors, classification evolves over time.
Porter five forces explain profit competition between suppliers, buyers, entrants, substitutes and incumbents.
Unit-economics math assumes price 100, variable cost 65, fixed cost 20000, volume 1000; synthetic.
FCFF/WACC corresponds to firm value; FCFE/cost of equity corresponds to equity value.
Synthetic 5-year FCFF [100,110,120,130,140], WACC 10%, stable g 3% yields EV about 1726.79 and TV PV share about 74.07%.
Gordon terminal value requires WACC>g and reinvestment and growth assumptions must be consistent.
P/E, P/B, PEG require positive and consistent denominators; a negative P/E lacks standard cheapness meaning.
Steady-state justified P/B formula (ROE-g)/(Ke-g) assumes clean surplus and sustainable reinvestment.
PB = PE × ROE only with exactly matched book denominator and equity/earnings scope.

limitations: All figures and calculations are original synthetic illustrations, not market price or forecasts.
Automated static structural and browser QA checks do not replace external link freshness and factual review.
Financial reporting and market-specific trading rules must be reverified as they evolve.
Chapters 11–15: derived indicators are features, not tested forecasts; constructed valuation and covariance matrices are hypothetical.

Chapters 16–20: all calculator inputs and diagrams are synthetic teaching examples; risk models, factor premia and behavioral findings have sample- and assumption-specific scope. No local-market return is asserted without a separate point-in-time test.

Chapters 21–25: POR proxy is not the full original value-band factor, PB–ROE requires specific steady-state assumptions, and examples/quant_lab.py is an offline teaching program with no live trading functionality.
Chapters 26–28: AI classification is not return prediction; sentiment, FX and risk examples are synthetic and no live AI model or market feed is called.

Chapter 27 partial FX hedge and risk-contribution experiments are educational approximations; forward points, basis, carry, collateral, changing correlations and actual instrument liquidity are not priced.
Chapter 28 capstone_lab.py is an offline research skeleton, not a production optimizer, fully featured event-driven backtester or live execution platform.
